title: Number Types Venn Diagram
subject: Algebra I
Number Systems and Properties
Real Numbers
description: Interactive p5.js simulation demonstrating classification and set inclusion across rational and irrational numbers.
creator: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the hierarchical relationship between different number types
Understand that each inner set is a subset of the outer sets
Classify numbers into their appropriate categories
Recognize examples of each number type
Distinguish between rational and irrational numbers
prerequisites: Basic understanding of positive and negative numbers

controls.name: Show Labels
controls.description: Toggle visibility of number type labels

controls.name: Hover Tooltips
controls.description: Hover over any region to see a detailed explanation of that number type

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive visual modeling with step-by-step exploration and immediate feedback
keyQuestions: What mathematical relationship is illustrated by this model?
How does changing one variable or parameter influence the outcome?
commonMisconceptions: Confusing visual scale or orientation with underlying numeric operations
assessmentOpportunities: Explain the displayed relationship in student's own words
Solve an algebraic problem and confirm result with the interactive model

learningObjectives: Categorize numbers as rational or irrational and understand their union as the set of real numbers.
prerequisites: Introductory familiarity with variables and algebraic expressions
